cards.title: Publish the framework
cards.text: A tag of a package's own name releases it to GitHub Packages, packed, guarded and pushed by the run's own token.

cards.title: Tag a release
cards.text: LouisAgent.Core-0.2.0 on a commit of main; packages that belong together, tagged together.

cards.title: More than three tags
cards.text: GitHub makes no event for them: push them, then delete and push one again.

cards.title: The guard
cards.text: A package whose framework dependency is neither in the batch nor on the feed stops the run.

cards.title: Check it from outside
cards.text: consume-packages.yml restores the packages with only a run's token and runs an agent.
